title: The Lab
body: The Community Technology Lab is a new initiative, launching in 2027 as a fellowship programme. Over a 10-week school, four fellows will take part in a funded and collectively directed period of research and design, culminating in a tool or artwork that responds to community needs. The programme includes production support, co-design sessions, guest-led workshops, and a showcase. The Lab aims to expand public participation in technological discourse through hands-on experimentation in order to develop new models for community-led innovation that are inclusive, culturally grounded, and designed with care. More details will be announced in January 2027.
